findings.title: Silence menu item shown in list view but its drawer never opens
findings.body: In the list view `rulerRule` is undefined, but `canSilence` now also comes from the Grafana prom-rule ability, so the 'Silence notifications' item renders. Its click calls `handleSilence`, which sets `showSilenceDrawer`. In RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx the drawer is rendered only when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true, and `rule` is undefined here, so nothing opens. The menu item is a dead control for every Grafana rule in the list view.

findings.title: Delete and pause items are unreachable in list view despite Grafana abilities
findings.body: `canDelete` now includes the prom-rule ability, but the Delete item is still gated by `canDelete && rulerRule`. The list view never passes `rulerRule`, so Delete is never rendered for Grafana rules there, even when the user has permission. Likewise the pause item (line 123) requires `rulerRule` via `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)`, so the new `canPause` grafana branch has no effect in the list view. The abilities were wired up but the rendering conditions were not updated, so the feature is silently incomplete.

findings.title: GrafanaRuleListItem rendered in list without a React key
findings.body: The diff removed `key={key}` from the `GrafanaRuleListItem` element in the filtered results map, while the `datasource` and `unknown` branches still set keys. Rules are rendered from an array that grows via concat, so React will warn about missing keys and may reuse or misplace DOM/state between items when the list is updated. The `key` was already computed (`ruleWithOrigin.key`) and should be kept.

findings.title: Link to rule view drops the returnTo parameter
findings.body: The previous GrafanaRuleLoader built `href` with `createRelativeUrl(..., { returnTo })`. The new GrafanaRuleListItem uses `createRelativeUrl(`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view`)` without returnTo, so navigating from the list to a rule and pressing back/cancel no longer returns the user to the list with its filters.

findings.title: Removed coverage for Creating/Deleting states and matchRules logic
findings.body: The tests for rules that exist only in the ruler (Creating) and only in Prometheus (Deleting), and the matchRules unit tests, were deleted together with the behaviour. Nothing replaces them, and the list view no longer surfaces rules in these transitional states at all. The PR does not add tests that cover the new behaviour where ruler-only actions are unavailable, such as Silence and Delete from the list.
